fields.name: insulation_core_type
fields.rationale: The insulation core type is explicitly mentioned as 'rigid thermoset polyisocyanurate (PIR) fibre-free insulation core', which is a key characteristic of the product.
evidence: Therma™ TW55 R is an insulation board with a rigid thermoset polyisocyanurate (PIR) fibre-free insulation core.
